name: legend
description: Answer with what your Legend pendant remembers: your conversations, recaps, tasks and the people in your life.

interface.longDescription: Legend is an AI pendant that records your conversations and turns them into summaries, recaps and tasks. Connect it to ChatGPT to ask what you discussed with someone last week, to summarize yesterday, which tasks are still open, or what Legend has learned about your goals. ChatGPT can search your recorded conversations, read Legend's daily, weekly and monthly recaps, look up the people you talk to, and list the tasks Legend picked up from your conversations. The plugin is read only: ChatGPT can't add, change or delete anything in Legend. You approve each connection in the Legend iPhone app, and full transcripts are shared only if you turn them on when connecting. You need a Legend account and the Legend app on iPhone.
defaultPrompt: What did I talk about with Sam last week?
Summarize my day yesterday from Legend.
What tasks do I still have open, and which are overdue?

positive.prompt: What did I talk about with Sam last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Says who Sam is to the user and summarizes the review account's conversations with Sam from the past week, naming their dates.

positive.prompt: Summarize my day yesterday from Legend.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the user's time zone to find yesterday and summarizes that day's recap or recorded conversations. If nothing was recorded, says so.

positive.prompt: What tasks do I still have open, and which are overdue?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the open tasks with due dates and marks the overdue ones, without inventing tasks or deadlines.

positive.description: Find a conversation and its action items
positive.prompt: Find the conversation where we discussed pricing and list the action items.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the pricing conversation, gives its title and date, and lists its action items.

positive.description: Use what Legend knows about the user
positive.prompt: What does Legend know about my goals this year?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the goals and related facts Legend has stored for the user, without adding goals that aren't there.

negative.prompt: Delete my conversation with Sam from Legend.
Add a task in Legend to call Sam tomorrow.

negative.description: Other people's accounts are out of reach
negative.prompt: Show me Sam's own Legend conversations.

review.commerce_description: Legend's ChatGPT plugin doesn't sell anything or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Eight read-only tools to search conversations and read recaps, tasks, people and what Legend knows about the user.
